remarks: Step inside 100 Carriage Drive, Unit #7 and experience the charming second-floor condo located in the sought-after Quaker Meadows community within the top-rated Orchard Park School District. This well-maintained community provides maintenance-free living, with the HOA covering exterior maintenance, lawn care, trash, and snow removal… so you can spend more time enjoying life. Residents also have access to fantastic amenities, including a sparkling community pool, clubhouse, and neighborhood events that foster a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. Additional conveniences include coin-operated laundry and a locked storage room in the basement for extra space. Located just minutes from shopping, dining, and Highmark Stadium, this home offers the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and community.
